label: SELF-WORTH

points.heading: Go for the people you love
points.body: Focus on the friends and family you’re glad to see.
points.panel: Pick two people you really want to catch up with.

points.heading: Have a short answer ready
points.body: For the “so are you seeing anyone?” question.
points.panel: “Not right now, and I’m enjoying this chapter.”

points.heading: Wear what makes you feel good
points.body: Confidence often starts with feeling comfortable.
points.panel: Choose the outfit that feels most like you.

points.heading: Bring a friend or a plan
points.body: An exit plan makes it easier to relax.
points.panel: “Want to go together? We can leave whenever.”

points.heading: Leave when you’re done
points.body: You don’t have to stay until the end.
points.panel: “I had a lovely time. I’m heading home.”

caption:
Holiday parties can feel different when you’re newly single: the couples, the questions, the memories.

You don’t have to dread them. With a little planning, they can be fun again. These five ideas help you show up as yourself and enjoy the night. This chapter deserves celebrating too.

Save this for party season, and follow @roundabloom for more gentle steps.
